title: Leading Design Through Complexity
subtitle: Leading UX direction and cross-functional collaboration on a confidential digital experience.

info.label: Focus
info.value: UX leadership, collaboration, stakeholder alignment and design direction

paragraphs: Some of the most interesting design challenges go beyond the screens. They’re about bringing people together, navigating different perspectives and finding a clear direction.
This project has given me an opportunity to lead UX direction, collaborate closely with another designer and work across teams to shape a complex digital experience.
This project is confidential and still in development, so detailed project information isn’t publicly available.
